items.html:
Fresh Linux audit complete; no reruns or edits.

Dataset Observations Passed gates Diagnostics Failed
Physics 337 320 17 0
Paper spectra 59 29 30 0
Cluster conditioning 248 48 193 7

Paper spectra contain 853 samples/backend plus 15 native refinements. Shapes, finite values, matching reference grids, fixture hashes, cylinder correction, and endpoint exclusion all verified.

  • Author-table absolute errors: sphere 4.8304e-9, cylinder 2.6577e-12.
  • Executed-notebook errors: sphere 4.10e-17, corrected cylinder 7.26e-17.
  • Array power-balance error: 3.77e-15 interior; 9.35e-11 near the threshold, passing its 2e-10 gate.
  • Native cutoff sensitivity remains diagnostic: sphere 0.2385%, cylinder 0.6168%, array 1.0979e-4 absolute.

Conditioning is an explicit failed qualification, despite successful collection. At L8, full matrix, low-order block, and assembled system fail entrywise agreement. At L12 those fail again, plus all nine illuminated scattering/extinction/absorption values: maximum absolute disagreement 5.9172e-7, relative L2 2.3098e-5.

Native L8→12 cross-section change is 2.9648e-10, versus upstream 2.3098e-5. This supports investigating upstream high-cutoff instability, but does not independently certify native correctness. The unbalanced system condition estimate reaches 4.22e22; componentwise residual maxima approach one for both implementations despite tiny normwise residuals.

Outputs under benchmarks/results/comparison/linux/accuracy-physics/results/:

  • accuracy-physics.json
  • accuracy-papers.json
  • accuracy-cluster-conditioning.json

Fixed the native L8 error by applying LAPACK’s standard 0.1 equilibration threshold, replacing the overly permissive sqrt(epsilon) trigger. Native assembly was accurate; the skipped equilibration lost digits.

Independent upstream-assembled, balanced references now qualify all neighboring cutoffs:

Lmax Native/reference max error Certified reference uncertainty Original tolerance ratio, including uncertainty
6 1.22e-17 1.24e-14 0.0124
8 1.65e-17 2.07e-14 0.0207
10 1.30e-17 3.11e-14 0.0311
12 1.39e-17 4.35e-14 0.0435

Passing threshold remains 1. The certificate bounds the encoded upstream linear system, with arithmetic envelopes and independently checked 80/120-digit residuals; it excludes assembly, truncation, and physical-model error.

The unbalanced upstream L12 result has a demonstrated absolute error of at least 3.1781e-8 against that encoded system. Original disagreements remain archived.

Linux evidence: benchmarks/results/corrections/cluster-reference/linux.json.

Three helper tests and three native conditioning tests passed. Sources frozen; no active processes, installs, commits, or pushes. Root owns combined verification and performance reruns.

Threshold reference: LAPACK ZLAQGE.
